models.name: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash
models.title: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash（DeepSeek）
models.summary: DeepSeek 于 2026-09-10 正式发布的新架构家族最小型号，原生多模态视觉理解。官方称 552B MoE、非对称 Causal Encoder–Decoder（输入约 8B / 输出约 16B 活跃参数），API 模型名 `deepseek-flash`；旧名 `deepseek-v4-flash` / `deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp` 暂时路由到本模型。官方称多项测试上优于 V4-Pro，计划自 2026-09-14 北京时间 12:00 起将 `deepseek-v4-pro` 请求路由到 V4.1-Flash 并按 Flash 计价，直至 V4.1-Pro。基准分与缓存压缩数字一律标「官方称」，本库未复跑。
models.summaryEn: DeepSeek’s new-architecture family’s smallest model, officially released 2026-09-10, with native multimodal visual understanding. Vendor claims: 552B-parameter MoE with an asymmetric Causal Encoder–Decoder (about 8B active parameters for input / 16B for output); API model name `deepseek-flash`; the old names `deepseek-v4-flash` / `deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp` temporarily route here. DeepSeek says it beats V4-Pro on multiple tests and plans, from 12:00 Beijing time on 2026-09-14, to route `deepseek-v4-pro` requests to V4.1-Flash at Flash pricing until V4.1-Pro ships. Benchmark and cache-compression figures are all labelled vendor claims; not re-run by this library.

sources.label: Hacker News 讨论：DeepSeek v4.1 Flash
sources.labelEn: Hacker News discussion: DeepSeek v4.1 Flash

highlights.text: 官方称：API 模型名改为 `deepseek-flash`，原生多模态已上线；V4-Flash 与 V4-Flash-Vision-Exp 退役，旧名 `deepseek-v4-flash` / `deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp` 暂时路由到 V4.1-Flash。
highlights.textEn: Vendor claim: set the API model to `deepseek-flash`; native multimodal is live. V4-Flash and V4-Flash-Vision-Exp are retired; `deepseek-v4-flash` / `deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp` temporarily route to V4.1-Flash.

highlights.text: 官方称：552B 参数 MoE，新 Causal Encoder–Decoder 架构，输入侧仅 8B、输出侧 16B 活跃参数；新家族最小型号，带原生视觉理解。
highlights.textEn: Vendor claim: 552B-parameter MoE with a new Causal Encoder–Decoder architecture — 8B active parameters for input, 16B for output; the smallest model in the new family, with native visual understanding.

highlights.text: 官方称：与上一代相比 KV cache 只需 1/4 HBM、1/8 SSD 存储；缓存命中费用在 Agent 成本里占比大，压缩缓存可显著降本。
highlights.textEn: Vendor claim: versus the previous generation the KV cache needs 1/4 the HBM and 1/8 the SSD storage; cache-hit charges are a large share of agent costs, so compressing the cache cuts them significantly.

highlights.text: 官方称：Change Log 列出 GPQA Diamond 90.9、HLE 36.8（纯文本子集 39.1）、Codeforces Rating 3471、Terminal-Bench 2.1 90.6、DeepSWE v1.1 74.2 等；本库未复跑。
highlights.textEn: Vendor claim: the Change Log lists GPQA Diamond 90.9, HLE 36.8 (39.1 on the pure-text subset), Codeforces rating 3471, Terminal-Bench 2.1 90.6, DeepSWE v1.1 74.2, among others; not re-run here.

highlights.text: 官方称：V4-Pro 将有序退役 — 2026-09-14 北京时间 12:00（04:00 UTC）起，所有 `deepseek-v4-pro` 请求路由到 V4.1-Flash 并按 V4.1-Flash 价格计费，直至 V4.1-Pro 发布。
highlights.textEn: Vendor claim: V4-Pro is being phased out — from 12:00 Beijing time (04:00 UTC) on 2026-09-14, all `deepseek-v4-pro` requests route to V4.1-Flash and bill at V4.1-Flash rates until V4.1-Pro launches.

highlights.text: 官方称：API 价格随发布下调，2026-09-10 04:00 UTC 生效；沿用峰谷计价，谷时为峰时价的 50%。具体数字以 Models & Pricing 当日页为准。
highlights.textEn: Vendor claim: API prices cut with the release, effective 04:00 UTC on 2026-09-10; peak/off-peak pricing continues, off-peak at 50% of peak. See the Models & Pricing page for the day’s figures.

models.qualityNote: 来源为 DeepSeek 官方文档（新闻页与 API Change Log）与 Hugging Face 模型页；基准与架构数字均为厂商自述，本库未独立复测；定价以 Models & Pricing 当日页为准。HN 讨论帖只作社区热度参考，其链接指向 DeepSeek 官方 X 帖。预览图取自 DeepSeek 官方文档社交卡，非本模型专图。
models.qualityNoteEn: Sources are DeepSeek’s official docs (news page and API Change Log) plus the Hugging Face model page; benchmark and architecture figures are vendor claims, not independently re-tested here; pricing per the Models & Pricing page on the day. The HN thread is only a community-interest pointer and links to DeepSeek’s official X post. Preview is DeepSeek’s docs social card, not a model-specific image.

models.name: GPT-6 Astra
models.title: GPT-6 Astra（OpenAI）
models.summary: OpenAI 2026-09-03 发布的前沿模型。官方定位：电脑操作、浏览、软件工程、网络安全、科研与专业办公；ChatGPT 内可用 Sites 从一条提示直接生成并托管网站、Web 应用与游戏；API 名 gpt-6-astra。社区侧：YouWare 9 月 8 日发帖称已整理 720+ 条 Astra 社区作品（游戏原型、3D 世界、产品 UI、动效、模拟），附提示词可在 YouWare 复跑。
models.summaryEn: OpenAI’s frontier model, announced 2026-09-03. Official pitch: computer use, browsing, software engineering, cybersecurity, science, and professional work; in ChatGPT, Sites builds and hosts websites, web apps, and games from one prompt; API name gpt-6-astra. Community side: on 8 Sept YouWare posted that it sorted 720+ community Astra builds (game prototypes, 3D worlds, product UIs, motion, sims), prompts included to replay on YouWare.

sources.label: YouWare：720+ 条 Astra 社区作品（X 视频帖）
sources.labelEn: YouWare: 720+ community Astra builds (X video post)

highlights.text: 官方称：电脑操作、浏览、软件工程、网络安全、科研与专业办公达到 SOTA；FrontierMath Tier 4 98%、ARC-AGI-3 99.9%（官方自述）。
highlights.textEn: Vendor claim: state of the art on computer use, browsing, software engineering, cybersecurity, science, and professional work; FrontierMath Tier 4 98%, ARC-AGI-3 99.9% (OpenAI’s figures).

highlights.text: 官方称：发布日先向少数组织开放，随后数日扩到 ChatGPT Plus / Pro / Business / Enterprise，以及 OpenAI API、Azure、AWS Bedrock；企业工作区默认关闭，需管理员开启。
highlights.textEn: Vendor claim: rolling out first to a limited set of organizations, then over the coming days to ChatGPT Plus / Pro / Business / Enterprise, plus the OpenAI API, Azure, and AWS Bedrock; off by default for Enterprise workspaces until an admin enables it.

highlights.text: 官方称：API 标准价 $10 / 百万输入 token、$50 / 百万输出 token；Fast mode 双倍速双倍价。
highlights.textEn: Vendor claim: API standard pricing $10 per million input tokens and $50 per million output tokens; Fast mode is 2x speed at 2x price.

highlights.text: 官方称：Preparedness Framework 下首个到达网络安全「Critical」级别的模型，公开版会拒绝高阶攻击性任务。
highlights.textEn: Vendor claim: first model to reach the Critical cybersecurity level under the Preparedness Framework; the public version refuses advanced offensive tasks.

highlights.text: 社区 showcase：YouWare 称整理了 720+ 条 Astra 作品并附提示词；视频里的「Astra Replay」页面显示 721 projects / 29 playable / 24 full prompts。
highlights.textEn: Community showcase: YouWare says it sorted 720+ Astra builds with prompts; the “Astra Replay” page in the video shows 721 projects / 29 playable / 24 full prompts.

models.qualityNote: 两类来源分开看。官方模型页是 OpenAI 公告与安全综述：基准分、推出节奏、价格均为厂商自述，本库未独立核实。社区 showcase 是 YouWare 的 X 视频帖：「720+ 条作品」是 YouWare 自己的说法，帖内 t.co 只指向该视频，没有独立画廊链接；视频里的 Astra Replay 页面未能确认公开 URL，故不写深链，只列 YouWare 产品主页。预览图取自该 X 视频封面（YouWare 页面，非 OpenAI 官方图）。本条是最新模型看板的第一张卡，不是 Grok Bot 用法。
models.qualityNoteEn: Two kinds of source, kept apart. The official model page is OpenAI’s announcement and safety overview: benchmarks, rollout, and pricing are vendor claims, unverified here. The community showcase is YouWare’s X video post: “720+ builds” is YouWare’s own count; the post’s t.co resolves to the video itself, not a separate gallery. The Astra Replay page in the video has no confirmed public URL, so no deep link — only the YouWare product home. Preview is the X video poster (a YouWare page, not an OpenAI image). First card on the latest-models board; not a Grok Bot playbook.

models.name: Astra mini-LoL demo
models.title: Astra 复刻迷你 LOL（社区 demo）
models.titleEn: Astra recreates a mini League of Legends (community demo)
models.summary: 社区 demo：@konstiwohlwend 9 月 8 日发帖称，让 GPT-6 Astra「照抄英雄联盟」，它真做出来了，附约 44 秒视频；封面帧是选人界面，Garen / Ashe / Ahri / Lux / Lee Sin 五英雄、5v5（你 + 4 队友对 5 个机器人）。中文转述来自 @LufzzLiz（岚叔）同日帖，并把作者两步提示词译成中文：先「做一个跟 LOL 一样的游戏，先 5 个英雄」，再骂回去「这是廉价山寨，先写计划、按真实尺寸与机制实现、UI 要原生不许 HTML 贴上去」。本卡只记模型能力展示，不是可下载的游戏。
models.summaryEn: Community demo: on 8 Sept @konstiwohlwend posted that he asked GPT-6 Astra to copy League of Legends “and it actually did,” with a ~44s video; the poster frame is a champion-select screen with Garen / Ashe / Ahri / Lux / Lee Sin, 5v5 (you + 4 allies vs 5 bots). The Chinese write-up is @LufzzLiz’s same-day post, which also renders the author’s two-step prompt in Chinese: first “build a game exactly like LoL, start with 5 champions,” then push back “this is a cheap clone — plan first, implement real scale and mechanics, UI must be native, not HTML pasted on top.” Catalogued as a model-capability showcase only, not a downloadable game.

sources.label: 作者原帖：让 Astra 照抄 LoL（X 视频帖）
sources.labelEn: Author’s original post: asked Astra to copy LoL (X video post)

sources.label: 岚叔中文转述 + 两步提示词（X 帖）
OpenAI 公告：GPT-6 Astra（所用模型）
sources.labelEn: OpenAI announcement: GPT-6 Astra (the model used)

highlights.text: 作者称：「让 Astra 照抄英雄联盟，它真做出来了，真英雄都在」；原帖只有视频（约 44 秒），提示词说在回复里，本库没能抓到该回复。
highlights.textEn: Author’s claim: “asked Astra to copy League of Legends and it actually did, with the real champions”; the post is video only (~44s), the prompt is said to be in a reply this library could not fetch.

highlights.text: 提示词第一步（岚叔中文转述）：做个跟英雄联盟完全一样的游戏，LOL 有什么它就得有什么 — 同一张图、画质对得上、英雄小兵塔；先选 5 个英雄起步。
highlights.textEn: Prompt step 1 (as rendered in Chinese by @LufzzLiz): build a game exactly like League of Legends — same map, matching visuals, champions, minions, towers; start with 5 champions.

highlights.text: 提示词第二步（岚叔中文转述）：骂回去 — 这不是 League，是廉价山寨；先写计划，再按真实尺寸和机制精确实现；UI 不许 HTML 贴在上面，要原生、好看、像真游戏。
highlights.textEn: Prompt step 2 (as rendered in Chinese by @LufzzLiz): push back — this is not League, it is a cheap clone; write a plan first, then implement real scale and mechanics precisely; UI must be native, not an HTML overlay, and look like a real game.

highlights.text: 封面帧可核到的：选人界面列出 Garen（战士）/ Ashe（射手）/ Ahri（法师）/ Lux（法师·辅助）/ Lee Sin（战士·打野），Ahri 面板生命 590 / 攻击 53 / 射程 550 / 移速 330 / 护甲 21 / 魔抗 30，召唤师技能 Flash + Heal，5v5「你 + 4 队友 · 5 个敌方机器人」。
highlights.textEn: Visible in the poster frame: a champion-select screen listing Garen (fighter) / Ashe (marksman) / Ahri (mage) / Lux (mage · support) / Lee Sin (fighter · jungle); Ahri’s panel reads health 590 / attack damage 53 / range 550 / movement speed 330 / armor 21 / magic resist 30; summoner spells Flash + Heal; 5v5 “you + 4 allies · 5 enemy bots.”

models.qualityNote: 这是社区 demo 卡，不是模型卡：模型本体见同板的 GPT-6 Astra。主源是作者 @konstiwohlwend 的 X 视频帖，「Astra 真做出来了」是作者自述，本库只看了约 44 秒视频与封面帧，没有拿到可玩的构建或下载，玩法深度、是否完整 5v5 均未核实。作者说提示词在回复里，本库抓不到该回复，因此提示词只能引 @LufzzLiz（岚叔）的中文转述，标为「岚叔中文转述」，非作者原文。OpenAI 公告只是所用模型的官方页，不涉及此 demo。英雄联盟 IP 属 Riot Games：本卡只记「模型能力展示」，不收录、不分发任何游戏文件。封面帧里的英雄名与属性数字是画面原样抄录，不是本库的判断。预览图为作者 X 视频封面（已裁掉下方黑边）。不打星。
models.qualityNoteEn: A community-demo card, not a model card: the model itself is the GPT-6 Astra card on this board. Primary source is the author @konstiwohlwend’s X video post; “Astra actually did it” is the author’s claim — this library only watched the ~44s video and poster frame, has no playable build or download, and has not verified depth of play or a full 5v5. The author says the prompt sits in a reply this library could not fetch, so the prompt is quoted from @LufzzLiz’s Chinese rendering and labelled as such, not as the author’s original wording. The OpenAI announcement is only the official page for the model used; it does not cover this demo. League of Legends IP belongs to Riot Games: this card records a model-capability showcase and neither hosts nor distributes any game files. Champion names and stat numbers are transcribed as shown in the frame, not a judgement by this library. Preview is the author’s X video poster with the bottom black band cropped. Unrated.

Pitch is coding, knowledge work, and long-running / agentic tasks, plus early research demos. Already catalogued as AI news in the Grok Bot library; this is the board card, full copy lives on that entry.
